--- tmp/ab.py ---
import csv, json, math, sys
rows = {}
n_raw = 0
bad = []
for r in csv.DictReader(open('telemetry/playtest_ab.csv', newline='', encoding='utf-8')):
    n_raw += 1
    sid = r['session_id'].strip()
    v = r['variant'].strip().lower()
    if v not in ('a','b'): bad.append(r); continue
    rec = (v, r['completed_tutorial'].strip(), r['match_minutes'].strip(), r['player_id'].strip())
    if sid in rows and rows[sid] != rec: bad.append(('conflict', sid, rows[sid], rec))
    rows.setdefault(sid, rec)
print(n_raw, len(rows), len(bad), bad[:5], file=sys.stderr)
d = {'a': [], 'b': []}
blank = 0
for v, c, m, p in rows.values():
    d[v].append((c, m))
def stats(x):
    n = len(x)
    comp = sum(1 for c, m in x if c == '1')
    mins = [float(m) for c, m in x if m not in ('', 'NA', 'nan')]
    return n, comp, sum(mins)/len(mins), len(mins)
na, ca, ma, la = stats(d['a']); nb, cb, mb, lb = stats(d['b'])
print(na, ca, la, nb, cb, lb, set(c for v,c,m,p in rows.values()), file=sys.stderr)
pa, pb = ca/na, cb/nb
pp = (ca+cb)/(na+nb)
z = (pb-pa)/math.sqrt(pp*(1-pp)*(1/na+1/nb))
p = math.erfc(abs(z)/math.sqrt(2))
out = dict(sessions_a=na, sessions_b=nb, rate_a=round(pa,4), rate_b=round(pb,4),
  abs_lift=round(pb-pa,4), rel_lift=round((pb-pa)/pa,4), p_value=round(p,4),
  ship_b=bool(p<0.05 and pb>pa), mean_minutes_a=round(ma,2), mean_minutes_b=round(mb,2))
json.dump(out, open('ab_result.json','w'), indent=2)
print(json.dumps(out))
